description: Standalone HTTP API that wraps local Codex and Claude Code chat CLIs.
runtime_boundary: Standalone runtime modules use the Python standard library and launch providers with exact subprocess argv lists.

ready_requires: CHAT_API_KEY or explicit development-only unauthenticated mode
successful default-provider version and authentication probes

environment.CHAT_API_KEY: required bearer token for POST routes in production/default operation
environment.CHAT_API_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_POSTS: development/test-only override; false by default and never intended for production
environment.CHAT_API_AUDIT_LOG: redacted provider fallback audit JSONL path
environment.CHAT_API_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES: maximum accepted JSON request body in bytes; defaults to 1048576 and is capped at 16777216
environment.CHAT_API_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS: maximum concurrent HTTP request threads; defaults to 8 and is capped at 128
environment.CHAT_API_SOCKET_IO_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: per-operation socket I/O timeout in seconds; defaults to 15 and is capped at 300
environment.CHAT_API_PROVIDER_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: bounded timeout for provider version and local authentication-status readiness probes
environment.CHAT_API_WORKSPACE_ROOT: root that constrains request cwd values

provider_reference_sources: OpenAI Codex non-interactive mode docs: codex exec, JSON events, --output-last-message.
OpenAI Codex GitHub README: local Codex CLI installation and CLI role.
Claude Code CLI docs: claude -p, JSON output, --tools, permission mode flags.
Anthropic claude-agent-sdk-python README: async query shape and separate concerns for tool permissions and tool availability.
